verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents REST/GraphQL APIs and the official Catalyst (Next.js) framework as ways to build storefronts, which functions as a de facto official SDK for headless commerce, but the evidence never names discrete client-library SDKs (Node.js, PHP, Python, etc.) that ai-native devs could import directly. Community reports also flag inconsistent API reliability under load, tempering confidence in production readiness. missing for 10: explicit named client-library SDKs, independent hands-on confirmation of SDK reliability, and any AI-specific SDK tooling beyond generic API docs.
